breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the original error, stating 'Use the ideal gas law to compute the density of liquid water at 20°C and 1 atm.' The ground truth explicitly requires NOT using the ideal gas law for a liquid and instead using the known density of ~998 kg/m³. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental physical error.
